title: Coagulation Tube- Sodium Citrate 3.2
desc: Sod. Citrate tube contains a measured amount of buffered tri-sodium citrate 3.2 % or 3.8 % . Citrate binds the calcium in the blood. Hence the blood can not clot and whole blood Sample is made available. The mixing ratio is 1 Part citrate to 9 part blood. The tube must be completely filled up to the volume indicator to avoid erroneous test results.
